summary: The benchmarks are marking time near the lows. The Sensex has trimmed its loss slightly to about 900 points, but mid- and smallcaps are still down about 1.3–1.4% and no recovery has formed.

detail.leaders: Isolated stock-specific gainers; energy-linked names abroad
detail.laggards: Hindalco, Max Healthcare, Kotak Bank (top Nifty losers); Nifty MidCap −1.31%, SmallCap −1.43%
detail.tone: Much the same as noon: the Sensex headline loss has eased from about 1,000 to 900 points, but the Nifty is still around 22,830 and breadth is poor. The selling has paused rather than reversed.
watch: Whether the Sensex can recover more than half its loss before the close
The FII/DII flow print after the close

top.title: Europe opens flat; energy stocks gain on oil

more: Global risk appetite is subdued rather than panicked outside Asia
India is underperforming on its high sensitivity to oil
